decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero is arbitrary here, not “none of it” (G2.10): truncated, the lower limit 10–20 % of the spread below the lowest value (G2.11)
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “7.8 on 10”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis on two levels: row 2 2021, 2022, dividers between the groups

source.shows: a rating's zero is an anchor, not “none of it”, so a line may leave it out: the scale is truncated to the data (G2.8, G2.10); twelve months across two years, the years on row 2 with a divider at the new year
